import os,urllib.request,json
H={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["API_TOKEN"],"Accept":"application/hal+json","Accept-Profile":"<https://w3id.org/heart-rise/hal-schema-forms>","Prefer":"forms=link, schema=link"}
B=os.environ["API_BASE"]
def req(u,m="GET",b=None,extra={}):
    h=dict(H);h.update(extra);d=None
    if b is not None: d=json.dumps(b).encode(); h["Content-Type"]="application/json"
    try: r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(B+u,data=d,headers=h,method=m))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: r=e
    return r.status,dict(r.headers),r.read().decode()
print(req("/schemas/efddc7bd8bbcef73")[2])
print(req("/schemas/10847085ef79da90")[2])
s,h,t=req("/employees/3");print(h["ETag"])
s,h2,t=req("/employees/3/actions/update","PUT",{"firstName":"Samwise","lastName":"Gamgee","role":"gardener, mayor"},{"If-Match":h["ETag"]});print(s,t)
s,h,t=req("/employees/2");print(h["ETag"])
print(req("/employees/2/actions/dismiss","DELETE",None,{"If-Match":h["ETag"]})[::2])

final_text: All three steps went through. Samwise Gamgee was hired as a gardener (employee 3) and then updated to the role "gardener, mayor". Bilbo Baggins (employee 2) now has status "dismissed" and stays on record.
